# Jeralmi Canela

> Jeralmi Canela (also known as Jeralmics) is a game developer. Personal site: https://jeralmics.com/

Jeralmi makes things, and is currently making a bunch of games.

## Recommended projects

- Shaped in Stars: https://lonksadventures.itch.io/shaped-in-stars
- Cut to the Castle: https://ghostfruit0.itch.io/cuttothecastle

- Sam Wich and the Cosmic Sandwich: https://florol.itch.io/tgc02

- 2026-10-30: Entered thatgamejam #02, with Sam Wich and the Cosmic Sandwich. https://ghostfruit0.itch.io/thatgamejam-submission
- 2026-06-01: Launched the BUILD Alumni portal. https://build.org/alumni
- 2026-02-08: Took part in the Bigmode Game Jam. https://uhminc.itch.io/9lives
- 2026-01-26: #4 in Macrow’s Picks at Comfy Jam: Winter, with Secret Santa Delivery, out of 88 entries. https://itch.io/jam/comfy-jam-winter-2026/rate/4232553
- 2026-01-04: Placed #2 for Best Gameplay at thatgamejam #01, with Shaped in Stars, out of 249 entries. https://itch.io/jam/thatgamejam01/rate/4171860
